ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 (effective 1 March 2023); Government Decree No. 11/2023/ND-CP detailing AML/CFT measures; Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN guiding customer due diligence and record-keeping; Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14; Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration and beneficial owner declarations; the State Bank of Viet Nam's Anti-Money Laundering Decision No. 1283/QD-TTg approving the national AML strategy; relevant sanctions screening obligations under United Nations Security Council Resolutions and domestic implementing legislation.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the home jurisdiction is a party to the Apostille Convention, otherwise consular legalization by the Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport / civil identity issuing authority of the individual's country of nationality or habitual residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified notarized true copies followed by apostille or consular legalization; accompanied by sworn Vietnamese translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the Vietnamese law firm and authorized resident representative for pre-incorporation and license application
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the foreign investor or the individual beneficial owners, duly sealed and signed

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing commercial bank in the investor's home jurisdiction; auditor certification where available
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized certified copy of the bank letter and supporting statements, then apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO declaration and beneficial ownership statement complying with the form annexed to Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign investor and individual ultimate beneficial owners, certified by independent counsel or notary

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory initial and period screening of all investors, UBOs, directors and authorized signatories against the OFAC SDN List, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List and the Vietnamese domestic sanctions/AML database as administered by the State Bank of Viet Nam and the State Securities Commission; ongoing transaction monitoring and refresh screenings at least every 6 months; enhanced due diligence and senior management approval for Politically Exposed Persons and high-risk third-country investors.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal (Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp) - https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All company names must be written in the Vietnamese language script and must contain the legal form designation 'Công ty TNHH' (Limited Liability Company); a corresponding English translation or transliteration may be additionally registered but the Vietnamese name shall prevail for legal attribution; the name must be identifiable and not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered enterprise name in accordance with Articles 35-38 of the Law on Enterprises 2020.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected by the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) during pre-authorization screening on the National Business Registration Portal, the applicant may file a written complaint with the provincial DPI within 10 working days of receiving the rejection; if the DPI fails to respond or restates the rejection, a further administrative appeal may be lodged with the Minister of Planning and Investment under the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13; alternatively, the applicant may immediately submit a revised application with a corrected, clearly distinguishable name; if rejection is based on prior trademark rights or protected enterprise names, the applicant must obtain and submit a written no-objection letter from the right holder before re-filing.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for a venture capital general partner entity; a physical Vietnamese lease/office address is mandatory for enterprise registration and for obtaining the tuple license from the State Securities Commission; virtual office or administrative service addresses are insufficient to demonstrate commercial substance and would be rejected during regulatory vetting.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High risk - approximately 70% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months of operation by the Department of Planning and Investment, the State Securities Commission or local public-security authorities, given the foreign-owned financial-services classification and licensing condition requiring on-site substance review.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, Articles 22, 25, 26, 28, 47, 63, 74 and 75; Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 38-40; Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on Business Registration; Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP on implementation of the Law on Investment; Law on Securities No. 54/2019/QH14 and Decree No. 30/2023/ND-CP on securities investment fund management for licensed venture capital fund management activities.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office (Division) of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) where the head office is domiciled; for foreign-invested LLCs, the Investment Registration Division of the same DPI, using the National Business Registration Portal at https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Enterprise Registration Application (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp) together with the company charter and supporting documents; foreign-invested projects must first complete the Investment Registration Certificate Application (Hồ sơ đăng ký đầu tư) and obtain an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) before submitting for the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No general statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to a limited liability company under the Law on Enterprises 2020. Founding members must fully contribute their subscribed capital within 90 days from the date of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate. However, if the entity will act as a licensed venture capital fund management company, the legal capital floor is VND 5,000,000,000 (approximately USD 200,000) under Decree No. 30/2023/ND-CP, which must be held in a blocked Vietnamese dong bank account in the company’s name and evidenced when applying for the Securities Investment Fund Management License.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED at the first board meeting of the founding members of [Company Name] Limited Liability Company, duly convened in accordance with Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, that: (1) the Company Charter is adopted in full; (2) the founding members subscribe to 1,000,000 ordinary voting units at a par value of VND 10,000, representing a total charter capital of VND 10,000,000,000, and such capital shall be contributed by wire transfer into the Company’s bank account within 90 days as required by law; (3) the head office located at [full street address, district, city/province], Viet Nam is adopted as the Company’s registered office for all legal, tax, and administrative purposes; (4) Mr./Ms. [Full Name], nationality [ ], is appointed as the Company’s Legal Representative and Managing Director/General Director with exclusive authority to execute corporate documents, open bank accounts, engage counsel, and represent the Company; (5) Mr./Ms. [Full Name] is appointed as Chief Compliance Officer responsible for securities registration, fund-management licensing, and ongoing regulatory filings; (6) the Company shall procure an official corporate seal, notify the seal sample to the Business Registration Office, and open direct investment and operating accounts at [Licensed Bank]; (7) the Managing Director is instructed to submit the Investment Registration Certificate application, Enterprise Registration application, tax registration dossier, and, where applicable, the Securities Investment Fund Management License application to the State Securities Commission; and (8) the Company’s first accounting period, tax-code registration, and e-invoice system shall be established in accordance with Vietnamese tax law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Create Corporate Seal and Notify Seal Sample
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office, provincial DPI; corporate seal creator registered with the Ministry of Public Security.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the ERC is granted, the legal representative may have a corporate seal made. The company is free to determine the seal form and content under law. Within 15 days of first use, the company must notify the seal sample through the National Business Registration Portal. The portal will publish the seal sample in the national corporate registry.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Certificate of seal specimen from the seal engraver
Notification form for seal sample
Legal representative’s ID/passport
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the online notification is rejected due to data errors, immediately correct the form and re-notify. A company that fails to notify a seal may not rely on the seal for court or contract purposes; the remedy is to file after-the-fact notification together with a written explanation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open Capital Contribution Account, Escrow Bank Account and Operating Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial banks in Viet Nam; State Bank of Viet Nam for direct investment account oversight.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a foreign-direct-investment capital account (VND and foreign-currency transactions) and a working operating account at a licensed bank. Members must remit capital contributions by wire transfer within the 90-day statutory deadline. The bank must issue a Capital Contribution Confirmation stating the paid amount and date; this document is required for notarization of contribution and for the State Securities Commission if a licensed fund-management capital threshold must be met.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Investment Registration Certificate
Company Charter and member list
Corporate seal and seal sample notification
Legal Representative’s ID/passport and boarding certificate
Certificate of investment capital contribution for direct investment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If contribution is delayed, the company must file a revised member list with DPI showing the new contributed capital or carry out procedures for changing charter capital. If a licensed fund-management capital is required, the shortfall must be topped up before the SSC license application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publish Company Formation Details on the National Business Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office, DPI; National Business Registration Portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of the ERC issuance, the company must publish the prescribed information (ERC number, name, address, capital, legal representative) on the National Business Registration Portal. The online publication application is processed electronically; the publication fee is payable in addition to the registration fee.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Application for publication of enterprise information
List of constitutional contents for publication
Receipt of publication fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication is interrupted, the company can re-submit online; after successful publication, the portal issues a publication confirmation. Failure to publish may lead to administrative fines and invalidate certain filings, so immediate corrective publication is mandatory.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete Tax Registration and E-Invoice Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Tax Department (Cục Thuế), General Department of Taxation (GDT); online tax portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The ERC automatically creates a corporate tax code. The legal representative must log into the national tax portal to set up electronic tax filing, verify tax-payer status, register the accounting method, and create an e-invoice account using licensed e-invoice service providers. Also file the registration of payroll and social insurance if hiring employees. Annual CIT, VAT, and finalization declarations become due according to the first fiscal year.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate and tax code
Investment Registration Certificate
Company Charter and member list
Legally certified signature of legal representative for tax file
E-invoice registration form
Accounting software or outsourcing contract description
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority refuses or withholds e-invoice activation, request a written decision, correct data, and re-file. Administrative remedies under the Tax Administration Law include written opposition within 30 days and subsequent appeal to the GDT.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Securities Investment Fund Management License from the State Securities Commission (if acting as licensed GP)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Securities Commission (SSC), Ministry of Finance, Socialist Republic of Viet Nam.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The venture capital general partner management entity must be duly incorporated before applying as a securities investment fund management company. Prepare a comprehensive application package demonstrating legal capital of VND 5 billion, fit-and-proper governance, qualified personnel, internal control policies, IT systems, and risk management. The SSC reviews, consults with the State Bank if necessary, and issues the operating license for securities investment fund management. This license enables the entity to organize and manage venture capital funds under a GP management model.
required_dossiers: Application for issuance of Securities Investment Fund Management License
Valid Enterprise Registration Certificate
Investment Registration Certificate bearing the licensed fund-management activity
Proof of legal capital (blocked-bank confirmation, minimum VND 5,000,000,000)
Company Charter and governance regulations
Curriculum vitae and professional qualifications of senior managers and compliance officer
Description of internal control, risk-management and IT networks
Fund-management business plan and compliance manual
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SSC requests additional documents, the applicant has 30 working days to perfect the dossier. A negative decision must state the legal grounds; the applicant may request reconsideration to the SSC within 30 days, then appeal to the Minister of Finance, and ultimately to an administrative court.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: State Securities Commission (SSC) under the Ministry of Finance for the fund-management operating license; provincial Department of Planning and Investment for IRC/ERC; Fire Prevention and Rescue Police (C07) under the Ministry of Public Security for physical fire safety; Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) for environmental registration.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Securities Investment Fund Management License (Giấy chứng nhận đăng ký hoạt động quản lý quỹ đầu tư chứng khoán) — authorizing the venture capital general partner to organize, manage, and administer early-stage technology investment funds under the venture capital fund regime.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) for full EIA; provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) for environmental registration and environmental licenses.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Office-based venture capital fund administration is not an industrial project and does not ordinarily trigger a full EIA. The establishment of a head/administrative office that generates domestic wastewater above the category II threshold requires environmental license/registration under Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP. If no discharge source exists, the enterprise may self-certify exemption from environmental registration; otherwise the DPI/DONRE registers the project under Category III environmental registration.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Comply with QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT for domestic wastewater; QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT for industrial emissions if any auxiliary equipment is installed; QCVN 01:2009/BXD for building structures; and hazardous-waste notification and handling protocols set out in Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP. No volatile organic compound (VOC) or industrial wastewater thresholds apply because no manufacturing processes are involved; any small office and sewage flows must still meet municipal sanitary sewer acceptance standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Before occupying the registered office, the company must obtain fire prevention design appraisal and fire safety acceptance from the Fire Prevention and Rescue Police (PCCC) if the office building falls under the list of high-risk premises. A Fire Safety Eligibility Certificate is issued for premises where the statutory fire-safety conditions are met. Workplace compliance requires occupational safety training, occupational hygiene monitoring, and accident insurance enrollment under the Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH13 and the Labor Code No. 45/2019/QH14. Structural load checks on the leased office floor, a valid building use certificate, and administrative signboard permission from the district urban-management office must also be obtained.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế - GDT) of the Ministry of Finance, Socialist Republic of Viet Nam. Primary digital channels: the unified national electronic tax portal Etaxvn (https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn), the e-invoice portal (https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn), and the National Business Registration Portal (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn). The GDT also operates the dedicated foreign-supplier tax portal for cross-border digital/e-commerce suppliers without a Vietnamese establishment, which became the mandatory registration and filing channel on 1 May 2025 under Law No. 56/2024/QH15 amending the Law on Tax Administration. All VAT, CIT, license-fee, and e-invoice administration is exercised at the national level; there are no provincial or municipal VAT regimes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1 - Investment registration: the foreign-invested LLC must first obtain an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) from the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) or, for export-processing enterprise (EPE) projects, from the relevant Export Processing and Industrial Zone Authority. Step 2 - Enterprise registration: file the dossier on the National Business Registration Portal to obtain the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC); under the one-stop-shop mechanism (Articles 30 and 34, Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14), the statutory tax identification number (Mã số thuế - MST) is granted automatically and simultaneously with the ERC, so no separate tax-registration application is required. Step 3 - Electronic account activation: activate the Etaxvn tax account using a recognized legal-representative digital signature certificate (USB token or certified e-signature), register the LLC's bank accounts, and enroll in the e-invoice, VAT, CIT, and license-fee (môn bài) filing calendars. Step 4 - Sectoral licensing: because the scope ISIC 6499 requires a statutory license for fund management activity, the relevant State Securities Commission license or concession must be in place before fee-earning services commence; the MST remains the single integrated identifier for all tax accounts. Step 5 - Withholding registration: register the LLC's obligations to withhold foreign contractor tax and personal income tax on payments to non-resident advisers and employees. Where the VC fund itself is a non-resident vehicle with no Vietnamese permanent establishment, no separate VAT ID is required for the fund; the GP invoices under its own MST.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Viet Nam does not operate a US-style check-the-box or partnership pass-through election; the LLC is per se a resident entity-level CIT taxpayer at the standard 20% rate. Available statutory elections include: (i) investment-incentive elections - CIT exemption (up to 2 years) and 50% reduction (up to 4 years), or a 10% preferential CIT rate, for qualifying projects under the Law on Investment and Decree 218/2013/ND-CP; (ii) loss carry-forward - CIT losses are carried forward up to 5 consecutive years with no carry-back, applied by the taxpayer in the return rather than by separate filing; (iii) science and technology fund election - appropriation of up to 10% of taxable income to the Technology Development Fund is deductible within statutory limits; (iv) transfer-pricing certainty election - voluntary application for a unilateral or bilateral Advance Pricing Agreement (APA) under Circular 45/2021/TT-BTC; (v) e-invoice modality election - coded e-invoices cleared in real time by the GDT versus non-coded e-invoices transmitted within 24 hours of issuance; and (vi) tax-deferral and installment-payment elections for qualifying restructuring or force-majeure circumstances under the Tax Administration Law. Hybrid mismatch elections are unavailable; Decree 132/2020/ND-CP applies transfer-pricing documentation rules and a general anti-avoidance rule (GAAR) that may recharacterize hybrid instrument returns or interposed offshore fund structures.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam, 'SBV') - the sole central bank and foreign exchange administration authority of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. FX policy is administered by the SBV Foreign Exchange Administration Department under the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange No. 06/2013/UBTVQH13 (as amended and supplemented), Decree No. 70/2014/ND-CP detailing the ordinance, Circular No. 15/2015/TT-NHNN governing foreign exchange control for foreign direct investment activities, and Circular No. 02/2016/TT-NHNN governing foreign exchange derivatives. All licensed commercial banks must report foreign exchange transactions to the SBV through the balance-of-payments and foreign-exchange supervision reporting system.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vietnam operates a bifurcated convertibility regime. Current-account transactions are generally freely convertible: cross-border payments for services, management fees, advisory fees, royalties, profit remittances, and other current items may be executed through licensed banks with only documentary verification and SBV balance-of-payments reporting; no prior SBV approval is required for recurring profit remittances once the Corporate Income Tax finalization and audited accounts are completed. Capital-account transactions are controlled and require prior registration or approval: inbound charter capital contributions must be effected through a registered Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) opened at a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank; offshore shareholder loans must be registered with the SBV before drawdown under Circular No. 15/2015/TT-NHNN and related foreign-loan regulations; outbound investments by the Venture Capital General Partner require an Investment Registration Certificate / Decision on Outbound Investment under the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14. Profit remittance hurdles are practical rather than approval-based: the remitting bank requires the annual audited financial statements, CIT finalization dossier, tax clearance documents, shareholders' resolution on distribution, and a board resolution on dividend/management-fee remittance. Capital repatriation upon dissolution or partial withdrawal is permitted only after full settlement of Vietnamese tax and commercial liabilities, completion of liquidation procedures, and bank verification of the liquidation plan and audited accounts. The regime therefore allows full convertibility of current earnings but strictly gates capital movements through DICA mechanics, SBV loan registration, and outbound-investment licensing.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vietnam currently imposes no mandatory conversion ratio on export proceeds; exporters may retain 100% of foreign-currency export earnings in foreign currency accounts without forced sale to the banking system. However, statutory repatriation applies: all export proceeds must be received into a foreign-currency account held with a licensed credit institution in Vietnam within 15 days from the date the proceeds are credited to an account abroad (or from the contractual payment due date in cases specified by the SBV), in accordance with Circular No. 15/2015/TT-NHNN and the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange. Temporary retention offshore beyond 15 days is permitted only under SBV-approved exceptions, such as payment of costs directly related to the export transaction or repayment of foreign loans, and must be substantiated to the supervising bank. For the Venture Capital General Partner (ISIC 6499), export-proceeds surrender rules are not the primary operational mode; nevertheless, any management fees, fund-mandate advisory fees, milestone payments, or co-investment carried-interest related service income invoiced to offshore funds constitute service-export current-account receipts and must be repatriated to Vietnam within the same 15-day window and credited to the company's operational foreign-currency account or DICA as applicable. The bank will require the underlying service agreement, tax invoice, SWIFT credit advice, and a service-performance certificate for SBV reporting. No mandatory surrender or conversion to VND is currently in force.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA), operational VND/USD current accounts, and DICA-linked treasury products

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW as the primary statutory clearing rail; MEDIUM only as a supplementary collection-and-distribution overlay that immediately settles into a licensed onshore bank account. Legal constraints: (i) offshore digital EMI platforms such as Airwallex, Wise Business, Payoneer, and Neat are not licensed credit institutions in Vietnam and cannot hold a Vietnamese DICA nor open domiciled VND transaction accounts; (ii) any cross-border payment intermediary service acting for Vietnamese-resident customers requires an SBV intermediary payment service licence under Decree No. 101/2012/ND-CP (as amended by Decree No. 80/2016/ND-CP), and an unlicensed offshore EMI is therefore prohibited from actively marketing or providing domestic VND-corridor services; (iii) statutory capital contributions, shareholder loans, and outbound-investment disbursements must route exclusively through a DICA at a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank, so an EMI cannot satisfy capital-account compliance; (iv) fund balances held by an offshore EMI are commingled with the EMI's operational treasury and are not protected by Vietnamese deposit insurance; (v) the GP may lawfully use an offshore EMI only as a payment-acceptance convenience for offshore limited partners, with simultaneous onward SWIFT MT103 settlement into the Vietnamese licensed bank, and must retain the EMI's settlement statements, underlying invoices, and LP capital-call notices as evidence for the receiving bank's AML/KYC file. The practical recommendation is to treat the EMI as a non-account collection portal and not as the bank of record for capital-account or liquidity-clearing purposes.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is mandatory for corporate account onboarding. The LLC's legal representative and all authorized signatories must appear in person at the chosen bank's branch in Vietnam for identity verification, KYC interview, and AML vetting. Remote or fully digital video onboarding is not accepted for foreign-invested legal entities under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 (effective 01 March 2023) and the SBV's customer-identification regulations. Foreign members/directors may execute notarized and, where required by the bank, consular-legalized powers of attorney designating a Vietnamese-resident general director or an in-country corporate officer; the PoA-holder must physically attend with the original passport, proof of residential address, the original PoA, the LLC's Enterprise Registration Certificate, and the Investment Registration Certificate. If a corporate shareholder holds more than 20% equity, the bank will pierce the corporate veil: directors and UBOs of that corporate shareholder must also provide certified identification and register-of-directors extracts. Practical onboarding plan: (i) pre-clear the account type and required documentary checklist with the Institutional Banking/AML unit; (ii) prepare all constitutional documents in bilingual notarized Vietnamese/English translations; (iii) reserve 2-6 weeks for full onboarding; (iv) anticipate in-person second interview if the GP's business plan shows outbound capital deployment or if the fund structure includes jurisdictions considered tax-havens or high-risk; (v) appoint a local compliance officer and a deputy money-laundering reporting officer to evidence managerial substance in Vietnam.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity: the GP is owned or controlled through multiple offshore fund vehicles, nominee shareholder arrangements, or discretionary trust structures, preventing rapid identification of the natural-person UBOs.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full chain-of-title diagram from the GP down to every natural-person UBO; certified copies of the fund's limited partnership agreement, the GP's constitution/charter, the register of members, subscription agreements, and side-letter structure; passport copies and proof of residential address of all UBOs, directors, and the local general director; the register of beneficial owners filed with the Vietnamese enterprise registration authority; written UBO declaration on the bank's standard AML forms confirming ownership percentages and source of wealth; corporate registry extracts and director identifications for any corporate intermediate shareholders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Venture-capital and fund-management activities are internally classified by banks as higher-risk financial business, creating concerns regarding unlicensed deposit-taking, hidden fund solicitation, or unregulated securities dealing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and Enterprise Registration Certificate showing ISIC 6499; applicable licensing or no-objection letters from the State Securities Commission where the GP is affiliated to a regulated fund-management entity or where quasi-public fundraising is present; audited financial statements of the LLC; GP's written AML, KYC, and sanctions-compliance policies; fund constitutional documents proving that the VP GP does not accept public deposits and that all incoming capital consists solely of private structured capital calls from qualified LPs; formal legal opinion from Vietnamese securities/FO counsel confirming the entity is not engaged in prohibited deposit-taking, unlicensed lending, or unregistered public offering; a description of the fund's target portfolio and the GP's expected 2-6 year lock-up and distribution waterfall.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: No meaningful local substance: all managers, the investment committee, and majority shareholders are located offshore, with the Vietnamese LLC functioning only as a nominal legal shell.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid lease or co-working-service agreement for a registered Vietnamese office; payroll records with Vietnamese Social Insurance and Health Insurance contributions for local operations staff; appointment resolutions for the local general director, compliance officer, and money-laundering reporting officer; minutes of board/investment-committee meetings showing decisions executed in Vietnam or ratified by the Vietnamese entity; Vietnamese tax identification number and prior-period CIT/VAT filings; a complete functional-scorecard file showing that bank signatory authority, cash management instructions, and investment disbursement approvals are exercised locally on a dual-signature basis.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large and frequent inbound wires from offshore LPs whose origins and source of funds cannot be verified quickly, including confidentiality concerns raised by LPs regarding side letters and fund-level know-your-investor information.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Standardized LP-KYC pack: certificate of incorporation or registration of each LP, AML/KYC questionnaire, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds declarations, beneficial-owner identification, political-exposure questionnaire, and negative-media/the-World-Check screening reports; bank reference letters obtained from the LP's own banking institution; capital-call notices and contribution schedules precisely matching each inbound SWIFT MT103 credit; an Excel-based flow-of-funds ledger reconciling every capital call to the DICA credit advice; the fund's anti-money-laundering and investor-acceptance policy; an undertaking to provide enhanced due-diligence updates annually and upon any ownership change.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Imminent cash-out risk: the GP may quickly distribute committed capital back to offshore LPs or pay large, thinly documented management fees abroad before establishing a stable operational and investment track record.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The fund's distribution-waterfall model attached to the limited partnership agreement detailing carried-interest and return-of-capital mechanics; a management-fee budget and fee-invoice trail with service records and performance evidence; the GP's board minutes approving each distribution and each fee payment; Vietnamese tax computation and withholding summaries covering Foreign Contractor Tax, Corporate Income Tax, and Personal Income Tax as applicable; tax-payment vouchers and tax-clearance certificates; a legal opinion confirming that distributions are lawful profit/deemed-profit distributions and not disguised loan-back transactions or capital flight; the GP's treasury-account signatory matrix evidencing local dual-approval and audit oversight.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound capital injections from offshore investors into the Vietnamese LLC must be settled through the licensed bank via SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for intermediary-value moves), with the ordering customer being the legal investor and the beneficiary being the LLC. The payment-reference/purpose field must read as: 'Capital contribution - [investor legal name] - [Enterprise Code]/[IRC No.] - DICA'. The receiving bank will apply the credit to the LLC's Direct Investment Capital Account only after verification of: (i) the IRC and Enterprise Registration Certificate; (ii) the capital-contribution schedule annexed to the investment constitution; (iii) a board resolution approving the capital call; and (iv) investor identification. The transaction is then reported by the bank to the SBV in the foreign-exchange supervision and balance-of-payments portal. If the inbound remittance is an offshore shareholder loan to the GP rather than equity, the loan agreement must be registered with the SBV under Circular No. 15/2015/TT-NHNN and the foreign-loan registration regime before drawdown, and the wire must cite the SBV loan-registration code. If the inbound remittance is a management fee or advisory fee earned from an offshore fund, it is a current-account receipt and may credit an operational account rather than the DICA, supported by the service agreement, tax invoice, and GP's relevant tax filings. All inbound FX can be retained in USD if the bank permits a USD operational account, or converted into VND at the bank's quoted rate with an MT300 confirmation. The GP should also obtain a Foreign Investor Certificate/registration where required by securities law or by the bank's own domestic institutional policy, and must maintain a DICA-reconciliation workbook matching every inbound SWIFT credit advice to the capital-call schedule.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary clearing rail for outbound venture-capital disbursements is SWIFT MT103 executed via the licensed local bank from the LLC's operational or designated investment account. For investments into a Vietnamese portfolio company, the bank executes a local settlement: FX conversion (if required) plus a domestic IA/WA transfer credited to the target's DICA or operational account. For outbound investments into offshore SPVs or portfolio companies abroad, the GP must first obtain a Decision on Outbound Investment / amended IRC under the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 and complete the SBV outward-investment registration; the MT103 reference must identify the recipient, the investment agreement date and number, and the total disbursement. Supporting documentation for the bank file: executed share-purchase or subscription agreement, board resolution approving the deployment, valuation/cap-table substantiation, investor-side commitment letter, and, for loan disbursements to portfolio companies, the loan agreement and interest-payment schedule. A Commercial Letter of Credit (documentary LC under UCP 600) is a permissible clearing instrument but is not the standard rail for equity deployment; it may be used only where a portfolio company's trade settlement involves document-based goods transactions. All outbound disbursements must be recorded in the SBV foreign-exchange supervision report and tagged with the correct outward direct investment or operating-payment purpose code; the GP must retain the full transaction file for audit and for the annual foreign-exchange inspection by the SBV. Standing instructions should be filed to prevent disbursements to sanctioned jurisdictions, PEP-linked counterparties, or unregistered tax-haven structures without additional compliance clearance.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward contracts between USD and VND executed with a licensed Vietnamese credit institution, tenor generally capped at 365 days, valid only where a genuine underlying current-account or registered capital-account exposure exists; the forward must be supported by the underlying contract and bank-confirmed exposure documentation.

FX swaps (spot/forward or forward/spot) between USD and VND executed with a licensed bank under Circular No. 02/2016/TT-NHNN, with each leg documented against an actual foreign-currency cash-flow schedule such as capital calls, management fees, profit distributions, or portfolio-company divestment receipts.

Plain-vanilla FX options (call/put on USD/VND) bought from licensed Vietnamese banks, subject to the 365-day tenor limit, premium payment in VND or USD, and documentation of an underlying exposure; selling or writing uncovered options is not an appropriate or standard compliance posture for a GP without a specific treasury mandate.

Cross-currency interest-rate swaps and FX-linked interest-rate swaps for long-term offshore subordinated debt or mezzanine facilities, available only from banks with approved derivative programs and subject to SBV registration/notification of the underlying foreign loan.

Structured compliance note: offshore NDF (non-deliverable forward) contracts, synthetic VND instruments, offshore crypto/stablecoin corridors, and netting arrangements with unlicensed offshore counterparties are not permissible onshore hedging or clearing rails; all hedges must be executed with an SBV-licensed bank and documented in the GP's treasury ledger.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Duty Payment (Thuế Môn Bài)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation (through local provincial/city tax office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January of the operating calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest at 0.03% per day; administrative fines from VND 3,000,000 to VND 6,000,000; may be subject to enforcement suspension of tax obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return (Quyết Toán Thuế TNDN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local tax authority under the General Department of Taxation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year end for a calendar-year filer (by 31 March in practice)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest at 0.03% per day; late-filing penalties up to VND 100,000,000 or up to 100% of the underdeclared tax amount depending on severity; possible criminal referral for deliberate evasion

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Annual Financial Statements Submission for Foreign-Invested Entity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) and the local tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year end (calendar-year deadline is 31 March)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines from VND 10,000,000 to VND 30,000,000 for late or non-submission; repeated violations may trigger enterprise registration enforcement actions and project suspension review

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Investment Project Operation Report (Báo Cáo Tình Hình Hoạt Động Dự Án)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment / Industrial Park or Economic Zone Management Board (depending on project location)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 January, or as otherwise specified in the Investment Registration Certificate conditions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines from VND 10,000,000 to VND 20,000,000; may lead to administrative review and project compliance inspection, including suspension of investment incentives

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Personal Income Tax Finalization Payroll Declaration (Quyết Toán Thuế TNCN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local tax authority under the General Department of Taxation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year end; calendar-year entities submit by 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest at 0.03% per day; administrative fines up to VND 50,000,000 for incorrect or late declation of applicable tax amounts; possible penalty equal to 20% of underpaid PIT amount

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Labor Usage and Occupational Safety Report Submission
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Labor, War Invalids and Social Affairs (DOLISA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual labor usage report by 31 March; annual occupational safety report by 31 May for the preceding year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines from VND 5,000,000 to VND 20,000,000 depending on late submission; repeated non-compliance may trigger labor inspection and suspension of labor permit filings

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory annual independent audit applies to all foreign-invested enterprises in Vietnam regardless of size; additionally required for captive financial-type entities under the venture capital fund classification if state-owned shareholding or medium-enterprise thresholds are met
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) issued under Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC and supplemental circulars; IFRS may be adopted voluntarily for consolidated reports where parent is an IFRS filer but statutory statutory reports must be prepared under VAS

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No public annual UBO filing exists under Vietnam corporate law; however, under the Anti-Money Laundering Law and Circular 40/2019/TT-NHNN, the LLC must update and confirm beneficial owner identification evidence at least annually or upon any change, and record shareholding transfers in the Register of Members within 10 days of the transfer
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Legal Representatives
Business Registration Certificate and Supporting Documents
Minute Book of Members' Meetings and Board Resolutions

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 20% standard Corporate Income Tax (CIT) rate as set by the Vietnam CIT Law (Law No. 14/2008/QH12, as amended by Law No. 32/2013/QH13, Decree No. 218/2013/ND-CP)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Venture capital general partner management fee income is taxed at the standard 20% rate. Preferential rates of 10% for 15 years and CIT holidays of 4 years full exemption plus 9 years of 50% reduction are available only for qualifying new investment projects in encouraged sectors or geographic areas (e.g., high-technology, information technology, software production, and designated industrial zones), subject to conditions under Decree No. 218/2013/ND-CP, Decision No. 29/2021/QD-TTg, and related implementing guidance. Investment fund management and GP administrative services do not generally qualify for sector-specific preferences unless the GP's licensed entity is physically located in a qualifying high-tech or information-technology park and activities satisfy the strict registration and revenue conditions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Quarterly provisional return: Form 01/TNDN; Annual finalization return: Form 03/TNDN, both prescribed under Circular No. 80/2021/TT-BTC. Filing is mandatory through the Vietnam Electronic Tax Portal (thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn) or the integrated e-tax platform of the General Department of Taxation. The annual finalization return must be accompanied by audited financial statements (compulsory for foreign-invested enterprises) and, where applicable, the related-party transaction declaration (Form 01/QLGN per Decree No. 132/2020/ND-CP).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly provisional CIT declarations for the first three quarters of the fiscal year plus an annual CIT finalization return covering the entire fiscal year; the fourth-quarter provisional declaration is waived if the annual finalization return is filed on time.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly provisional returns and payments are due no later than the 30th day after the end of each quarter (30 April, 30 July, 30 October, 30 January). The annual finalization return and full settlement of any remaining CIT balance are due within 90 days after the end of the fiscal year, i.e., no later than 31 March for a calendar-year taxpayer. Quarterly provisional payments must in aggregate reach at least 80% of the final annual CIT liability; any shortfall below that threshold is subject to late-payment interest of 0.03% per day from the relevant quarterly deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reporting period: state the fiscal year (e.g., 1 January 2025 to 31 December 2025) or the short-period approved by the tax authority.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The GP must use the same fiscal year as its statutory books; non-resident investors cannot cause the Vietnamese LLC to adopt a foreign fiscal year unless a formal change is approved by the tax department.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification number (MST) of the enterprise, as stamped on the IRC/ERC certificate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the Vietnamese tax ID of the LLC only; do not use the non-resident fund or GP's overseas tax ID.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name, registered address, and enterprise code of the taxpayer in Vietnamese and English as per the enterprise registration certificate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the licensed in-country address of the GP; a representative office address or the offshore fund manager's address cannot be substituted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Charter capital, number of employees, and sector code (ISIC 6499 / VC fund management) used for tax accounting and statistics.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose full foreign ownership percentage; this field may trigger automatic scrutiny under the Law on Foreign Investment if licensed venture capital activity exceeds statutory limits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue: all turnover from management fees, carried interest, advisory fees, and other income from fund activities recognized under Circular No. 200/2014/TT-BTC (Vietnam Accounting Standards).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident-related revenue must be recognized gross without any set-off of costs; revenue paid by an offshore fund into the GP's Vietnamese account is taxable in Vietnam when the GP is a resident LLC performing the management function in Vietnam.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible expenses: legitimate business costs actually incurred with valid invoices and payment records, subject to the caps in Decree No. 218/2013/ND-CP and Circular No. 96/2015/TT-BTC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to offshore related parties are deductible only if supported by an arm's-length agreement (management services, advisory) and by transfer pricing documentation; entertainment expenses capped at 15% of wages; no deduction is allowed for allocated head-office overhead absent a valid cost-sharing agreement and VAT-compliant invoice.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income before loss carryforward: gross revenue minus deductible expenses minus tax-exempt income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Capital gains from equity disposals of Vietnamese portfolio companies must be separately tracked; capital gains on domestic shares are subject to CIT at 20% using the gain method, and non-resident investors selling capital in the Vietnamese GP itself are treated under separate FCT rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Loss carryforward: total accumulated tax losses actually offset in the current year, limited to the immediately preceding five years from the current tax period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses are ring-fenced to the GP LLC and cannot be transferred to, or utilized by, the offshore fund or other group entities; any re-attribution of losses among related parties is a transfer pricing red flag.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable CIT rate: insert 20% for the standard rate; insert 10% only where a valid investment incentive certificate or tax preference registration is approved.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If preferential rate applies, attach the investment certificate and confirm the incentive commencement date; non-resident GP shareholders cannot derive the preference through the LLC unless the underlying project itself qualifies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final CIT payable for the year and quarterly provisional CIT amounts already paid, including the 80% provisional payment threshold calculation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any underpayment below the 80% provisional threshold will generate daily interest at 0.03% per day; a foreign treasury management team pressing for profit repatriation before the finalization deadline does not excuse underpayment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance due: positive amount means additional CIT to pay with the finalization return; negative amount means overpayment to be offset or refunded.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Overpayment refunds to foreign shareholders are not permitted directly; the refund claim belongs to the Vietnamese LLC; subsequent dividend remittance is a separate legal act.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: a warning for a 1-to-5-day delay with mitigating circumstances; a fine of VND 2,000,000 for delays up to 30 days; VND 4,000,000 for 31-60 days; VND 6,000,000 for 61-90 days; and VND 8,000,000 for more than 90 days (Article 59, Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14). Late payment interest of 0.03% per day applies to all unpaid quantities. Under-declaration that causes tax underpayment but does not amount to evasion is penalized at 20% of the underpaid tax; intentional evasion triggers a penalty of 1 to 3 times the evaded tax, plus potential criminal prosecution. Failure to file the related-party transaction return (Form 01/QLGN) attracts separate administrative fines under Decree No. 125/2020/ND-CP.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on dividends paid by a Vietnamese limited liability company to a foreign corporate shareholder. Vietnamese domestic law does not impose a withholding tax on after-tax profit distributions to foreign corporate investors; the profit remittance tax of the former foreign investment law was abolished with effect from 1 July 2015. Individual foreign shareholders, however, are subject to a 5% personal income tax on dividend income collected through the LLC's withholding obligation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because the domestic dividend withholding rate is already 0%, a tax treaty generally provides no additional relief and no treaty application is necessary for ordinary dividend distributions. For any payment that is re-characterized by the tax authority as management fee, interest, royalty, or capital gain, the foreign beneficiary or the Vietnamese payer must submit: (i) a valid Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by the foreign tax authority, legalized and translated into Vietnamese unless exempt under Circular No. 80/2021/TT-BTC; (ii) the prescribed treaty-relief application form attached to the annual or event-based declaration to the local tax office; and (iii) supporting substance documentation (board resolutions, service contracts, invoices, and evidence that the foreign recipient is the beneficial owner). Relief is applied at the withholding source only after the tax office accepts the dossier; over-withheld amounts can be refunded under Article 83 of Law No. 38/2019/QH14. Under the MLI Principle Purpose Test, treaty relief will be denied if obtaining the benefit was a principal purpose of the structure.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid by the Vietnamese GP to a non-resident for the use of IP, software, or technology are subject to Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) composed of CIT at 10% and VAT at 5% on the gross payment (total 15%). Vietnam's tax treaties commonly reduce the CIT component to 5%-15%, generally 10% for royalties; treaty relief requires a TRC and beneficial-ownership confirmation. Interest paid by the Vietnamese GP to a foreign lender is subject to FCT CIT at 5% on the gross interest, with no VAT; most Vietnamese DTAs fix interest at 10%, but bank and financial-institution interest is frequently reduced to 5% or lower. Payments characterized as interest on shareholder loans or back-to-back fund facility structures are subject to thin-capitalization and transfer pricing analysis under Decree No. 132/2020/ND-CP.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatory when the annual value of related-party transactions exceeds VND 30 billion. Master File and Local File are mandatory when the related-party revenue attributable to Vietnam exceeds VND 50 billion and the ultimate parent's consolidated global revenue exceeds VND 18,000 billion. A Country-by-Country Report is required when the ultimate parent group's consolidated revenue in the preceding fiscal year exceeds VND 18,000 billion. Enterprises below the documentation thresholds are still required to file Form 01/QLGN and maintain contemporaneous evidence of arm's-length pricing if they engage in related-party transactions.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Viet Nam does not maintain standalone Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) in the form used in Caribbean jurisdictions. Nevertheless, the economic substance doctrine is embedded in Decree No. 132/2020/ND-CP through the requirement that related-party transactions be priced on arm's-length substance, and in General Rule 18 of the Tax Administration Law requiring that the actual economic substance control transactions over their legal form. The Vietnamese GP of an offshore venture capital fund must be able to demonstrate local substance: a licensed office, substantive employment of fund managers, board decision-making within Vietnam, risk management, and local books and records. Decree No. 66/2025/ND-CP and Resolution No. 107/2023/QH15 implementing the OECD Global Minimum Tax impose a 15% top-up tax on multinational enterprise groups with consolidated revenue of EUR 750 million or more from fiscal year 2024; the GP is expected to reflect local substance in determining where economic profits are created. A GP operating as a shell with no Vietnamese substance will face re-characterization, denial of treaty benefits, and transfer pricing adjustments.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using fake or forged invoices (hoá đơn khống), under-declaring management fees or carried interest, claiming artificial deductible expenses, manufacturing offsetting transactions between the GP and the fund, or deliberately misclassifying income to reduce CIT and VAT liabilities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil administrative penalty of 1 to 3 times the evaded tax amount under Article 107 of Law No. 38/2019/QH14. Criminal prosecution under Articles 200, 201, and 202 of the Penal Code No. 100/2015/QH13 (as amended): legal entities may be fined up to VND 20 billion, suspended from operations for up to 36 months, prohibited from raising capital and issuing securities, and ordered to forfeit assets. All evaded tax, late-payment interest at 0.03% per day, and fines are collectible through seizure of bank accounts and assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative, CFO, and chief accountant can be personally criminally liable for corporate tax evasion. Individual sentences range from fines and prohibition from holding office to imprisonment of up to 20 years for aggravated evasion exceeding VND 4.5 billion. Directors who sign false CIT returns or approve fake invoices are subject to travel bans (temporary exit suspension), administrative summons, and disqualification from corporate management. Under Article 13 of the Law on Enterprise No. 59/2020/QH14, directors who cause tax losses through unlawful declarations must compensate the LLC in full.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the GP as a pure shell: no office, no employees, no local investment decision-making, with nominee directors and management exercised exclusively by the offshore fund sponsor; characterising all or substantially all operating income as being generated offshore while claiming Vietnamese tax residency for treaty benefits; circular capital structures where the GP re-invoices foreign expenses into Vietnam without value creation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority may disregard the legal form, disallow intercompany deductions, re-determine taxable income at a 20% CIT rate, impose a 20% under-declaration penalty on any shortage, and charge 0.03% per day interest. Failure to prepare or submit Local File, Master File, or CbC Report is separately sanctionable by administrative fines up to VND 25 million under Decree No. 125/2020/ND-CP, in addition to the right of the tax office to apply ex officio TP adjustments by re-characterizing the shell entity's income as attributable to a permanent establishment in Vietnam. Under the OECD Global Minimum Tax framework, profits allocated to a substance-free shell remain exposed to top-up taxation at the parent level.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and nominees of the shell entity may have the corporate veil pierced: they are jointly and severally liable for the LLC's unpaid CIT, VAT, and social insurance debts. Vietnamese courts have upheld personal liability for debts incurred without genuine board approval. Directors face exit bans, freezing of personal assets, and criminal charges under Article 200 of the Penal Code if the shell is used to route undisclosed profits. Foreign directors are equally subject to extradition and mutual legal assistance under Vietnam's international cooperation treaties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the venture capital GP without a valid securities/investment fund management licence, accepting capital calls in cash or through unlicensed money transmitters, structuring wires below reporting thresholds to avoid AML review, failing to submit Suspicious Transaction Reports (STR) to the Financial Intelligence Unit, or using the fund's portfolio companies to recycle illegal proceeds, including cryptocurrency-based layering.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines under the Law on Prevention and Combat of Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH12 may reach VND 5 billion for reporting failures. Criminal liability for money laundering under Article 324 of the Penal Code: individuals face imprisonment of 1 to 15 years; legal entities are fined up to VND 15 billion, forced to dissolve, or suspended for up to 36 months. Unlicensed venture capital activity additionally invokes administrative sanctions under the Law on Securities and the State Securities Commission, including fines up to VND 1.5 billion and compulsory return of investor funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers of the GP bear personal criminal exposure for deliberate avoidance of the AML framework; the AML Law expressly extends liability to the beneficial owner and the director responsible for the reporting obligation. Sanctions include travel bans, seizure of passports for pending investigations, personal fines, confiscation of assets, and imprisonment for up to 10 years for those organizing or materially assisting the laundering activity. Civil liability allows investors to sue directors directly for losses caused by non-compliance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Mispricing and Thin Capitalization
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Setting management fees or carried interest at levels deviating from independent comparables; allocating group head-office costs to Vietnam without a valid cost allocation arrangement; making interest-free or non-commercial loans to the fund or portfolio companies; back-to-back licensing of IP with no functional substance; and maintaining debt-to-equity ratios above 30% of equity for non-bank entities for thin capitalization purposes under Decree No. 132/2020/ND-CP.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority will perform a comparability adjustment, increase the GP's taxable income to the arm's-length level, impose CIT at 20% on the adjustment, apply a 20% penalty on the under-declared tax, and charge late-payment interest of 0.03% per day. Penalties for failure to produce TP documentation are up to VND 25 million per document and up to VND 50 million for persistent refusal, without limiting the tax office's power to adjust the income on an estimated basis. For large MNEs, failure to align TP outcomes with economic substance may also trigger Global Minimum Tax top-up of up to 15% on excess profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve TP policies without contemporaneous benchmarking are personally liable for civil damages to the company if the subsequent tax adjustment reduces distributable reserves. In flagrant cases of TP fraud, directors are treated as accomplices to tax evasion and can be prosecuted under Article 200 of the Penal Code, with imprisonment of up to 20 years for orchestrating artificial profit stripping. Travel bans and asset freezes are routinely imposed on directors of entities under TP criminal investigation.
